heroHeadline: HELSINGBORG T-8: SWEDEN ANNOUNCES RUTTE-KRISTERSSON BILATERAL AT MSB REVINGE — TOTAL DEFENCE MODEL ON DISPLAY; DUAL EMERGENCY TRACK OPERATIONAL; EU RED LINES SET; ANKARA SUMMIT JULY 7–8
heroSubtitle: On May 13, 2026, Sweden's government announced that NATO Secretary General Rutte will visit PM Kristersson, Defence Minister Jonson, and Civil Defence Minister Bohlin on May 21 for a bilateral meeting and demonstration at the MSB Civil Defence training centre in Revinge, Skåne — 30km from Helsingborg and 8 days before the emergency NATO Foreign Ministers Meeting (May 21–22). Rutte will observe air-threat management exercises and civilian-military cooperation showcasing Sweden's totalförsvar ('total defence') framework, the whole-of-society resilience model that integrates civilian government, private sector, and the population into national security alongside conventional forces. Background: May 12 — EU FAC Defence emergency session (Kallas chairs; NATO Deputy SecGen Shekerinska + Ukrainian FM Fedorov VTC; €63B Ukraine military support reviewed; €90B EU defense loan debated; Kallas: 'we must agree on our red lines'). May 11 — Rutte meets Ukrainian FM Sybiha at NATO HQ; Helsingborg configured as emergency session with four agenda clusters. May 10 — formal allied contingency planning. May 9 — Rasmussen 'disintegrating'; Italy/Spain drawdowns forecast. May 7 — 'terror incubators' CT strategy. May 1 — 5,000 from Germany. Next: Helsingborg FMM May 21–22 (emergency session); Ankara Leaders' Summit July 7–8, 2026.
